players.product: 10G/25G mobile fronthaul optical transceivers (SFP+/SFP28, tunable DWDM); 100G-400G PAM4 modules; 800G/1.6T in research

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 11,395,141 thousand (KRW 16,436,916 thousand in H1 2025); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 4,329,240,330 and operating loss KRW 2,077,767,050 (H1 operating loss KRW 3,800,467,876). Mobile optical modules (ODL) KRW 7,737 million (75.84%) and FTTH KRW 2,288 million on a separate basis.
Half-year report: main customers are Samsung Electronics, HFR and other domestic and overseas telecom equipment makers plus domestic mobile operators; the top five customers are about 80% of revenue.
Half-year report customer concentration: customer A KRW 2,269,343 thousand (20%) and customer B KRW 4,720,235 thousand (41%) of H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: A 49%, B 21%).
Half-year report: order backlog KRW 3,557 million (53,300 units) at 06-30-2026; orders KRW 8,099 million including backlog carried over.
Half-year report: H1 2026 utilisation for optical modules 75.8% (work efficiency 102.8%, productivity 78.0%).

Half-year report product status: 200G PAM4 and 400G PAM4 modules at mass-production stage; 100G PAM4 QSFP28-LR1 and 50G PAM4 SFP56 at pilot production; 800G, 1.6T and 3.2T PAM4 in research (government projects); a 100G/400G/800G/1.6T line-up was added for domestic and overseas data centre markets (development 2025.10-2026.12).

Company view (half-year report): estimates about 18% share of the domestic optical module market and about 1% globally; Chinese competitors are intensifying price competition, and the company is partnering with Chinese vendors to enter the Indian market.
